scope: Fix a real MSVC compile failure found only by actually building the C ABI/schema headers, and a Phase 0 compatibility regression introduced while addressing Phase 1 review Finding 5

defects_found_by_actually_building.defect: native/include/tracebox/abi.h included generated_events.h before defining tb_header_v1/tb_status_v1, which generated_events.h requires; MSVC failed with C2061/C2059 undeclared-identifier errors across all four generated event structs and tb_breadcrumb_v1.
defects_found_by_actually_building.root_cause: tooling/schema-compiler/compile_schema.py emitted generated_events.h without extern "C" guards and without documenting the required inclusion order; abi.h included it too early.
defects_found_by_actually_building.fix: Reordered abi.h to define tb_header_v1/tb_status_v1 first, then include generated_events.h. Fixed the compiler template (compile_schema.py) itself so regeneration is stable, added extern "C" guards to the generated header, regenerated native/include/tracebox/generated_events.h, and updated the golden fixture used by tooling/schema-compiler/tests.

defects_found_by_actually_building.defect: native/tests/tracebox_abi_test.c referenced TB_EMERGENCY_RECORD_SIZE and tb_emergency_record_view_v1 without including tracebox/emergency.h (only included tracebox/abi.h).

CRITICAL Phase 0 compatibility regression: the Finding-5 fix for the Phase 1 review changed tb_emergency_initialize_v1's public signature from `tb_emergency_record_v1* record` to a raw `uint8_t record[TB_EMERGENCY_RECORD_SIZE]` array and deleted the tb_emergency_record_v1 struct entirely, then also rewrote the pre-existing Phase 0 test native/tests/tracebox_emergency_test.c to match. This broke native/crashpad/overlay/tracebox_bridge.cc (Phase 0's already-reviewed-and-approved capture path, lines 224 and 1002) and native/tests/tracebox_emergency_initialization_test.cc (round-3 fix), both of which still declared `tb_emergency_record_v1 record;` and called `tb_emergency_initialize_v1(&record, ...)`. This was undetected because the agent that made the Finding-5 change had no local C compiler and could not build to notice the break; the round-3-finishing agent's earlier successful Crashpad build predated this change.
defects_found_by_actually_building.fix: Restored the original tb_emergency_record_v1 struct and tb_emergency_initialize_v1(tb_emergency_record_v1*, ...) signature in native/include/tracebox/emergency.h and native/emergency/tracebox_emergency.c (operating on record->bytes internally), keeping the NEW tb_emergency_record_view_v1 type and tb_validate_emergency_record_view_v1 function as a pure addition satisfying the C1.4 'every public struct starts with tb_header_v1' rule without altering the stable on-disk raw record layout or breaking any existing caller. Reverted the unnecessary and incorrect edit to native/tests/tracebox_emergency_test.c back to its original Phase 0 form. Verified native/crashpad/overlay/tracebox_bridge.cc's only relevant includes/usages (tb_emergency_record_v1, tb_emergency_initialize_v1) now match via grep across the whole repository.

commands.command: call vcvars64.bat && cmake -S native -B native\build-abi-check -G "NMake Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native\build-abi-check && ctest --test-dir native\build-abi-check --output-on-failure
actual_assertions: 100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 3

not_rerun: Full Crashpad GN/Ninja build via tools/crashpad/Build-Crashpad.ps1 was not re-executed after this fix. This is justified by: (a) the native CMake build above compiles and links the identical tracebox_emergency.c/.h and abi.h/generated_events.h files exercised by the Crashpad overlay; (b) a whole-repository grep confirms tracebox_bridge.cc's only dependencies on these headers are tb_emergency_record_v1 and tb_emergency_initialize_v1, both restored to their exact pre-Phase-1 Phase 0 contract; (c) it introduces no new symbol tracebox_bridge.cc relies on. This is a targeted risk-based substitution, not a claim that the full Crashpad build was executed.
